subject: Nfs/burnout
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: They seem to be getting closer every year.  Now nfs has crashes and burnout has freeroam.

subject: Kinda
author: Rofer
body: Yeah paradise is very different from Nfs, but it is more like NFS than any of the other burnout games are. I believe that they took away the essence of what makes burnout, burnout.

subject: not really the same...
author: eswat2
body: conceptually, they share some similarities but they really are very different games.  I beat ProStreet once and started a 2nd pass thru the game before Burnout Paradise was released.  While i enjoy both games, Burnout Paradise is much more interesting because of it's open world model (just my opinion).
